references.text: The relationship between the bridegroom and the bride as a picture of God's relationship with his people.
The use of the bride and the bridegroom as metaphors for the relationship between God and his people.
Jesus refers to himself as the bridegroom, suggesting his close relationship with his followers.
The call to meet the bridegroom can be seen in light of Christ's call to his disciples.
The marriage of the Lamb and the preparations for it as a picture of Christ's return.
The new Jerusalem, dressed as a bride for her bridegroom, illustrating the relationship between God and his people for eternity.
